nodes.name: rag_export
nodes.summary: Demonstrates the RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) export pipeline. Populates a SymbolicStore with a sample node, retrieves it via LocalRagAdapter, and exports the result to a PDF file using PdfExporter. Exercises the knowledge_export and rag_adapter public APIs end-to-end.

nodes.name: self_model_quickstart
nodes.summary: Quickstart walkthrough for the self-model metacognitive layer. Sequentially exercises CapabilityRegistry (registration), ResourceMonitor (linear-regression prediction), PerformanceTracker (EWMA/Bayesian metrics), HealthAggregator (weighted geometric mean), and DecisionEngine (expected-utility evaluation) using the hipcortex::self_model::* API.

nodes.name: world_model_example
nodes.summary: Minimal demonstration of the WorldModel API. Creates a WorldModel, adds a JSON state node ('robot'), and exports the internal graph, printing the node count. Serves as a smoke-test for the basic world-model construction and export path.

nodes.name: quickstart
nodes.summary: Demonstrates the semantic_compression module by building a float embedding vector and compressing it to a lower dimension via compress_embedding. Acts as the simplest possible entry point for new users exploring the crate.

nodes.name: mcp_server
nodes.summary: Launches the combined MCP server (REST on :8080, gRPC on :50051) when built with both web-server and grpc-server features. Wraps McpServer around a MemoryStore and calls serve; prints a clear error when the required features are absent.

nodes.name: dashboard
nodes.summary: Provides an Axum router (feature-gated on web-server) that exposes a /nodes endpoint returning all memory-record targets as JSON. Uses a shared Arc<Mutex<MemoryStore<B>>> where B implements MemoryBackend, making it backend-agnostic. Includes a tokio integration test that confirms the router builds without panicking.

nodes.name: decay
nodes.summary: Implements temporal relevance decay for memory traces. Defines DecayType enum (Exponential with half-life, Linear with duration, Custom fn pointer) and three pure functions: decay_exponential (half-life formula), decay_linear (proportional remaining), and apply_decay (dispatch). No external dependencies.

nodes.name: embedding_provider
nodes.summary: Defines the EmbeddingProvider trait and two concrete implementations: HashEmbeddingProvider (character n-gram hashing with FNV-1a, L2 normalised, no ML deps) and NoopEmbeddingProvider (zero-vector, for tests). Includes five unit tests covering determinism, dimensionality, L2 normalisation, semantic similarity ordering, and empty-input handling.

nodes.name: gui
nodes.summary: Tauri desktop GUI surface (feature-gated on 'gui'). Defines GuiState holding Mutex-wrapped instances of all core subsystems (SymbolicStore, TemporalIndexer, ProceduralCache, AureusBridge, MemoryStore, MonitoringService). Exposes Tauri commands: get_symbolic_graph, run_reflexion, send_perception, cli_command, get_metrics, and a launch() entry point.

nodes.name: memory_processor
nodes.summary: Small utility struct MemoryProcessor with a single deduplicate method that removes duplicate MemoryRecord entries from a Vec by UUID using a HashSet. Includes a unit test confirming duplicate removal leaves exactly one record.

nodes.name: plugin_host
nodes.summary: WASM plugin execution host feature-gated on 'plugin'. When enabled, PluginHost wraps a wasmtime::Engine and run_wasm instantiates a module, resolves a 'run' export, calls it, and returns its i32 result. Without the feature, a stub PluginHost returns an error unconditionally.
